title: Understand Third-Party Library Error
prompt:
Help me understand this cryptic error from a third-party library:

Error message: [PASTE FULL ERROR]
Library: [NAME + VERSION]
My code: [PASTE RELEVANT CODE]
What I was trying to do: [DESCRIBE]

## Error Translation
Translate this error into plain English:
What went wrong: [non-technical explanation]
What the library expected: [...]
What it got instead: [...]

## Library Behavior
Explain how this library works in the context of what I was doing:
- The correct usage pattern
- Where my code deviates from it
- Common mistakes that produce this exact error

## Root Cause in My Code
The specific line/block causing this: [CODE]
The problem: [explanation]

## Fix
Corrected code:
[CORRECTED VERSION with explanation of each change]

## Verify Fix
Test this to confirm the fix works: [test command or code]

## Documentation Pointer
The relevant section of the library docs that explains this: [section name / URL pattern]
Key paragraph: [describe what it says]
